As a TIG Welder, you will work closely with a small and experienced team to build high-quality stainless steel filter systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- TIG welding of stainless steel components (RVS/INOX)
- Assembling parts based on technical drawings

jobs.occupation: High Tech Mechanical Design Engineer Hengelo (236862)
jobs.description:
As a mechanical design engineer, you’ll be indispensable to the engineering team. You’ll be designing, analyzing, and improving mechanical systems. With your dedication, you can earn up to €3,800 per month and can count on a direct contract with the client right away. Want to know if this job is right for you? Then read on!

Your main responsibilities will be: 

    - Designing and optimizing complex mechanical components and rotating systems
    
- Developing technical solutions that prioritize performance, reliability, and manufacturability
    
- Conducting strength and stress analyses to evaluate structures and components 
    
- Selecting suitable materials for applications under high mechanical and thermal loads 
    
- Creating CAD models, technical drawings, and engineering documentation
    
- Collaborating with colleagues from Engineering, Production, and Testing to validate and further optimize designs
    
- Actively contributing to design improvements and the continuous optimization of products and processes

What's in it for you?

    - Gross salary ranging from €3,200 to €3,800 per month
    
- Travel allowance
    
- Full-time position (40 hours per week)
    
- Direct contract with the client

You bring the following experience and knowledge to the role:

    - At least a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a comparable technical field
    
- At least five years of experience as a Mechanical Design Engineer or in a comparable engineering role
    
- Experience designing complex mechanical systems or high-precision rotating components
    
- Knowledge of material properties, tolerances, and design principles for precision structures
    
- Experience with CAD software, such as Siemens NX or SolidWorks
    
- Experience with FEA analyses is a strong plus

In addition, you also possess the following:

    - Proficiency in spoken and written English, as English is the working language within the organization

Perhaps you are currently in a job where every day is the same. Time for something different – ​​variety, modern machinery, and a good salary with a shift allowance!

At Euromouldings in Nijverdal, you work as a production employee in a 5-shift system, which means you not only earn a good salary but also have extra free time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that plastic bottles and jerrycans are produced and packaged perfectly.

A job where you are actively engaged, work with technology, and every shift is different. Sounds good? Then be sure to read on 👇

Wat wordt er van je verwacht
As a production worker at Euromouldings in Nijverdal, you are an important link in the production process. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that the machines keep running and that every product meets quality requirements.

You work in a 5-shift system, which keeps your work varied and gives you plenty of free time. During your shift, you are constantly busy: you maintain an overview, intervene where necessary, and ensure that everything runs neatly and efficiently.

Specifically, what you will be doing:
- You pack plastic bottles and jerrycans in a neat and careful manner
- You check the quality of products and identify deviations
- You measure products using tools such as a caliper
- You assist in keeping the production lines running
- You work together with colleagues to ensure production runs smoothly

In short: you ensure that everything is right — from production to packaging.

Wat zoeken wij
For this position, we are not looking for a perfect CV, but the right attitude. Do you recognize yourself in this?
- You are 18 years or older
- You can work and think at an MBO (intermediate vocational education) level
- You are flexible and have no problem working in a 5-shift system
- You work accurately and have an eye for quality
- You can collaborate well and maintain an overview in a busy environment
- You speak Dutch and/or English

👉 Experience

Looking for a flexible job with a great salary where you can start right away? Come work as a warehouse worker at CB in Culemborg! With a starting salary of € 15,49 per hour (which can go up to € 28.13 per hour with shift allowances!) and a work atmosphere rated an 8+ by current employees, this is the place to be! You can work until the end of the year, at least. Sound like your ideal match? Continue reading and discover more! 🚀 #baanrader

What we offer
- A great starting salary of € 15,49 gross per hour!
- Allowances making your pay up to € 28.13 per hour!
- 100% public transport reimbursement!
- Work at a top employer rated an 8+!
- Choose your own shifts!
- Long term work and chance of permanent contract!

Who you are
To keep the book distribution center running smoothly, you meet the following objective requirements:

- You are available to work full-time (40 hours a week)
- You can work at least 2 of the following shifts: 06:30-15:00, 14:00-22:30, or 22:30-06:00
- You are available to work on Mondays until Fridays and/or Sundays

What will you do
As a warehouse worker at CB, your day will be filled with variety! You might unpack incoming pallets loaded with books and sort them into bins. Or you could be stationed at a pick station, scanning books into the computer system and labeling boxes for shipment. You ensure that orders are picked and prepared accurately so readers receive their favorite books on time. Easy peasy! 📚✨

Your daily activities as a warehouse worker at a glance:

- Unpacking incoming freight and sorting books into logistics bins
- Scanning, labeling, and registering books at high-tech picking stations
- Preparing orders neatly so your colleagues can send them out on transport

Where will you work
You will be joining the warehouse of CB in Culemborg as a warehouse worker! CB

Get an awesome salary of €16,78 and enjoy working dayshifts only! All while working with the best smelling flowers. Read on and watch your new job as an orderpicker blossom, literally. 🌸 Apply today at Royal FloraHolland in Honselersdijk! 🥳

What we offer
- € 16,60 bruto per hour
- Opportunity for a permanent contract!
- Travel allowance or public transport subscription
- Participation in staff association & fun events!
- Get €0,18 extra allowance. You'll get €16,78 p/h💸
- Enjoy free flowers up to 5 times a year! 💐

Who you are
To make sure everything runs smoothly, it's important that as an orderpicker, you'll meet the following requirements:

- You are available at least 3 days a week, especially on Mondays.
- You can start working at 05:45h and the ending time is between 09:30h and 12:00h.
- You have your own place to stay in The Netherlands.
- You are available at least till October.
- You speak Dutch or English.
- You can work in Honselersdijk.
- You meet the 1.65m height requirement.

What will you do
Every day, so many flowers leave Royal FloraHolland to be delivered to shops and florists across the country. 🌼 And they have to arrive fresh and flawless. Before the stores even open! That’s where you, as an orderpicker, come in.

Early in the morning, you’ll be working with carts full of beautiful flowers. You check if everything is correct: Are the flowers fresh and in good condition? Does the cart match the order?
Once everything is perfect, you roll the cart to the right spot. Then, a small electric vehicle (kind of like a mini lawn mower!) picks it up and brings it straight to the truck. Thanks to your work, the flowers arrive on time and in top shape at their destination! 🙌

Where will you work
You’ll be working at the world’s largest flower auction site! Yes, really! That’s how massive the warehouse in Honselersdijk (near Naaldwijk) is. As an orderpicker, you will find  your way around in no time though. Within weeks  you’ll be driving like a pro

Get started in logistics at a growing DHL location

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and start working quickly? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for warehouse employees.

This is a site that is still developing: new clients are regularly being onboarded, so no two days are the same and you will continuously learn new tasks.

What will you do?

- Picking orders using a scanning system
- Checking and replenishing products
- Packing orders and preparing them for shipment
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Supporting various processes depending on the client
- Ensuring a clean and safe working environment

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate in three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are available 32 to 40 hours per week
- You are flexible and can perform multiple tasks
- You are physically capable of warehouse work
- You speak Dutch or English

Experience is not required – motivation and commitment are more important. You will receive proper training and learn the job step by step.

In Dordrecht, we are located at Burgemeester van der Dussenstraat 910. Here, we work with our Central Hub Manager Rob and approximately 200 colleagues. Every day, we process up to 200,000 packages here, which can be sorted to 150 locations. In any case, wherever you work: we *always* listen to what you have to say. The more perspectives and opinions we hear, the better we all become. For instance, as an organization, we received the Great Place to Work certificate this year. This certification is based 100% on employee feedback.

As a logistics employee at DHL, you help sort packages. You ensure that every package ends up in the right place. Without your help, the packages would not be sorted on time and would not be delivered to the customer on time.

You can start as a ‘packer’, where you place the packages on the conveyor belt so they can be sorted. You can start as a ‘packer’, where you take sorted packages off the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. Later, at DHL, you can also learn and perform other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: a package can weigh a maximum of 25 kilos. Not every package is that heavy, but it can happen. You must always lift heavier packages together with a colleague.

Working hours/shifts vary between 17:00 and 02:00.

- You are available for at least 4 days a week between 17:00 and 02:00;
- You can lift packages weighing up to a maximum of 25 kilos;
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle, scooter, or you live within walking distance);
- You speak Dutch or English so that you can communicate well with your team.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- Residing in the area of Dordrecht / Rotterdam / Schiedam / Capelle aan den IJssel

Do you enjoy working accurately and do you have a valid Dutch work permit? Then this position is for you. For Arvato in Heijen, we are looking for motivated packing operators who ensure that products are correctly adjusted, packed and made ready for shipment. You will work in a dynamic logistics environment where teamwork, quality and safety are central. In addition, you have the chance of a contract upon good performance.

As a packing operator, you are responsible for carefully processing products before they are shipped. Your tasks include:

    - Depalletizing boxes, opening boxes and packaging
    
- Making space in packaging for documentation
    
- Adding a leaflet and manual to products
    
- Labeling and scanning boxes, plus stacking boxes on pallets

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Temporary contract via Manpower with the chance of direct employment upon good performance
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Travel allowance according to the employer’s policy
    
- Working in a modern and well-organized logistics environment
    
- Shift allowance (when working in shifts)

    - Able to work accurately with attention to detail
    
- Able to provide a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and a valid Dutch work permit
    
- Flexible regarding working hours (shift work) and overtime
    
- Good command of the English language
    
- Good physical condition and no physical complaints, due to the nature of the work

Do you want to work in a modern logistics environment where teamwork and quality are central? Apply today via Manpower and we will contact you as soon as possible to discuss the possibilities. You might soon start as a Packing Operator! 📦🚀

Do you know those delicious American Cookies at McDonalds and KFC? Have you always wanted to know the secret behind their recipe? Nice! Because now you can! If you start working as a production employee! Do you want to work with a salary of €33,85 per hour (shift allowance included)? Great! It's possible at Europastry in Steenbergen!

What we offer
- A nice salary of €16,12 gross per hour
- Higher hourly wage after 26 weeks - €16,99!
- Shift allowances between 38% and 110%!
- Travel expenses from 0,25 cent per kilometer

- Possibility to grow within the company

Who you are
To keep the factory running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a production worker:

- You speak Dutch or English;
- You have your own transport to get to Steenbergen;

What will you do
As a production employee at Europastry you work at the beginning of the cookie line. You are responsible for collecting and preparing all resources. Think of flour, butter and sugar! Then you weigh everything. And get everything ready for the batter. The batter for the cookies and muffins is made in large kettles. You also help with packing and cleaning work. The work is physically challenging. For example, you are busy lifting bags of ingredients and large baking trays on a daily basis. So, overall a lot of things to do!

You can work in 3 or 5 shifts:

- 🕕 06:00 - 14:00 uur
- 🕑14:00 - 22:00 uur
- 🌙 22:00 - 06:00 uur.

Where will you work
Now you are of course curious where you will be working? The tastiest company in Steenbergen of course! Everyone here knows each other. You will work here as a production employee at the cookie factory Europastry. Here they make cookies and muffins for large companies such as McDonalds, KFC and Lidl. Delicious! Wonderful to work with, isn't it?!  #baanrader
